expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row], li')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('crews-parent')); if (row) { row.click(); return 'clicked parent row'; } return 'no row found'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); const hasTree = t.includes('sub-agent-a') && t.includes('sub-agent-b'); const hasMcp = t.includes('mcp-sub-agent'); const hasForm = t.includes('delegate a sub-agent task'); return 'tree=' + hasTree + ';mcpChild=' + hasMcp + ';form=' + hasForm; })()
